<!-- Release: v0.11.5 -->

Development APK for Android 8 or newer. Signed with the project development key; updates the existing `.debug` app in place. Production distribution signing is not configured.

## Changes

- Blend full-background artwork into soft, curved color regions drawn from the cover
- Preserve spatial color detail through the fade, with gradual softening and lower shading
- Reuse a small filtered texture during player gestures

## Resolved issues

- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/41 - Natural artwork continuation beneath player controls

## Install

1. Download `localica-v0.11.5-debug.apk` from **Assets** below.
2. Open it and allow installation from your browser or file manager if prompted.
3. Install over your existing development app to keep its data.
